name: Online Records
author: SWOS United (SWOS 2020's challenge and speedrun records)
about: SWOS 2020's challenge and speedrun records on sensiblesoccer.de: who has beaten a challenge, the completion, the leaderboards, your records, the latest runs, the shared custom challenges. Logged in, your challenge wins and successful speedruns are sent there (a win also posted on Discord), and you can share your own challenges.
